artboards.title: B · Florentin Grit — ruled out by palette

annotations.text:
The top row is the decision, left to right along one axis:

A — flat, hairline, institutional
D — A's bones, with the sunset mechanism promoted sitewide and foam as flat blocks
E — Shoreline's air and a curved sea field, with A's flat discipline kept in the results rows
C — soft, coastal, pill-shaped throughout

Same content and the same real Ramat Aviv records in all four. Flip the Sunset toggle on each — that is where they differ most.

The designer named its own weak point in each.

D: the zmanim ribbon now carries a permanent sea tint, so the top of the page is no longer stark white — a feature or a compromise depending on how much you liked A's plainness.

E: the results rows use an 8px radius, chosen by eye between the hero's 24px and A's 2px. Worth judging whether that reads as considered or as neither-nor.
B is kept for the record but is out of the running: its ground is kurkar sand, which the white / sea / sunset palette excludes.
